Based on the initial skin inspection and the clinical picture of a common, self-limiting rash appearing in the newborn period, the most likely diagnosis is Neonatal Acne. This condition typically presents as papules and pustules on the face and upper trunk without systemic symptoms. No further testing is required at this time.
